svg.title: Agents, computer vision and machine learning
svg.desc: A Python-first editorial capability index with three equally weighted areas linked by number to projects below. Primary language: Python, with FastAPI, PyTorch, Pydantic and scikit-learn. Agents: RAG, workflows, LangChain, Ollama, projects 01, 03 and 04. Computer vision: ONNX Runtime, OpenCV, face-model integration, project 02. Machine learning: PyTorch, ResNet18, data preprocessing, training and evaluation, project 06. Full-stack delivery: Node.js, Next.js, React, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS and GitHub Actions. No proficiency scores are asserted.
